newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-ECE started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ECE started as buy.

text.p: Santander Investment said on Thursday it began coverage of newly listed restaurant operator ECE with a buy rating.
"The company has an outstanding growth track record," said analyst Lars Schonander.

ECE is Mexico's leading operator of theme restaurants with 13 restaurants, and the first to be listed on the Mexican stock exchange, he wrote in a report. It also operates franchises of Hard Rock Cafe, Planet Hollywood and Official All-Star Cafe, with rights to a Mexican franchise of the new Rainforest Cafe.

Last month ECE made an initial public offering worth 277.4 million pesos, with 25.2 million shares placed at 11 pesos each and 17.27 million new shares issued and 7.95 million shares sold in the secondary placement. Planet Hollywood International PHIIaq.L holds a 20 percent stake in the company
"Our 12-month target price of 16.00 pesos implies upside of 49.8 percent in nominal peso terms and 32.2 percent in U.S. dollar terms," Schonander wrote.
ECE's principal shares gained dropped six centavos in early trading to 10.34 pesos each.
